decisions.rationale: The complete report records 79 informative pairs across 4 dates with 100% agreement, but classifies the relation as L1-C, sets source_independence_confirmed=false, and has no independent evidence_sources. source_lineage.json still leaves the AxData provider lineage and FTShare REST underlying provider unconfirmed. Numerical agreement does not establish an independent cross-source identity; authoritative provider-lineage evidence is required before adjudication.

The fitted relation has validation R2=0.99996 on 18 samples across 3 stocks and 6 dates, but the exact Tencent [10] registry identity remains unverified with no canonical meaning or unit. Verified statistical inputs and distinct source families do not explain the target semantics. The generated regression is only a candidate: an authoritative fixed-version formula definition, explicit units, and a date-aligned derived-evidence CSV with tolerance replay are absent. Do not promote this relation without those materials.

The fitted relation has validation R2=0.999999 on 9 samples across 3 stocks, but its target zhb.full.change_pct already appears in a registered L1 mapping to tencent[32], which this report revalidates. This is not a new field identity. Formula-fit statistics alone do not justify a derived_relation decision; that path requires an authoritative definition and a date-aligned evidence CSV replay with verified units and independence checks. Keep it as a candidate.
